title: Bounded command execution
responsibility: Runs directly named commands with validated time and output limits, cancellation, controlled inherited environment, and process-group cleanup.

inputs.name: commandEnvironment.extra
inputs.description: Caller-supplied child environment entries are merged after inherited allowlisted variables, so they override matching inherited keys; values may be strings or undefined. It defaults to an empty object.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.checked.command
inputs.description: Executable name or path passed directly to child_process.spawn without a shell.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.checked.args
inputs.description: Arguments passed directly to the executable as separate strings, without shell parsing.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.checked.options
inputs.description: Sets the child's cwd, environment extras, stdin, timeout, combined stdout/stderr cap, abort signal, and optional spawn observer. The async defaults are six hours and 8 MiB; timeoutMs and maxBuffer must be positive safe integers no greater than 2,147,483,647.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.run.command
inputs.description: Executable name or path passed directly to child_process.spawn without a shell.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.run.args
inputs.description: Arguments passed directly to the executable as separate strings, without shell parsing.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.run.options
inputs.description: Sets the child's cwd, environment extras, stdin, timeout, combined stdout/stderr cap, abort signal, and optional spawn observer. The async defaults are six hours and 8 MiB; timeoutMs and maxBuffer must be positive safe integers no greater than 2,147,483,647.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.runSync.command
inputs.description: Executable name or path for a synchronous direct probe. Accepted shapes are ps; xcode-select -p; git --version, rev-parse, check-ignore, remote, or remote get-url with three tail arguments, optionally preceded by git -C and a path.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.runSync.args
inputs.description: Arguments passed directly to the executable, subject to the runSync direct-probe allowlist.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.runSync.options
inputs.description: Sets the synchronous child's cwd, environment extras, stdin, timeout, output buffer limit, and abort signal. Defaults are 60 seconds and 8 MiB; timeoutMs and maxBuffer must be positive safe integers no greater than 2,147,483,647, and maxBuffer is passed to spawnSync.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandFailure.constructor.message
inputs.description: Message stored on the Error instance and shown when the failure is reported.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandFailure.constructor.stdout
inputs.description: Captured stdout byte prefix attached to the failure; the adapter bounds collected output before constructing its command failures.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandFailure.constructor.stderr
inputs.description: Captured stderr text attached to the failure; the adapter bounds collected output before constructing its command failures.

inputs.name: commandLabel.command
inputs.description: Command string whose basename is used as a safe display label, without including argument values.

inputs.name: timeoutFailure.label
inputs.description: Safe command label included in the timeout error message.

inputs.name: timeoutFailure.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Deadline duration in milliseconds used to format the timeout error; values below 60,000 show milliseconds, and longer values also show rounded minutes.

inputs.name: commandOutput.maxBytes
inputs.description: Maximum combined number of stdout and stderr bytes retained by this collector; append returns false when a chunk does not fit completely.

outputs.name: commandEnvironment
outputs.description: Contains currently defined inherited variables from the adapter's allowlist plus all caller extras; caller entries overwrite inherited values.

outputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.checked
outputs.description: Resolves to the command's stdout Buffer only when its exit code is zero; a nonzero exit rejects with a BoundedCommandFailure carrying the captured stdout and stderr.

outputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.run
outputs.description: Resolves with exactly code, stdout, and stderr: a numeric exit code, captured stdout Buffer, and stderr decoded as UTF-8. Timeout, cancellation, launch, or output-cap failures reject.

outputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.runSync
outputs.description: Returns exactly code, stdout, and stderr, using status or 1 when status is null, an empty Buffer when stdout is absent, and UTF-8 stderr text or an empty string.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for invalid timeoutMs or maxBuffer bounds, a runSync command shape outside the direct-probe allowlist, or a synchronous child-process API error.

errors.name: BoundedCommandFailure
errors.description: checked rejects for a nonzero exit code; run and checked also reject with this type for asynchronous launch errors, deadline expiry, abort during execution, or combined output overflow. The failure carries the bounded captured stdout and stderr.

errors.name: AbortSignal.reason
errors.description: run throws the supplied reason unchanged when its signal is already aborted; checked propagates that reason as its rejection.

errors.name: onSpawn callback error
errors.description: run propagates any value thrown by the optional onSpawn callback after starting the child.

inputs.name: commandOutput.maxBytes

outputs.name: commandOutput
outputs.type: { append(stream: "stdout" | "stderr", chunk: Buffer): boolean; read(): { stdout: Buffer; stderr: string } }
outputs.description: Creates a stateful collector with append(stream, chunk) and read(); stdout is returned as a Buffer and stderr as UTF-8 text, with a shared byte cap.

outputs.name: BoundedCommandFailure.constructor
outputs.description: Creates an Error named BoundedCommandFailure with the supplied message and captured stdout Buffer and stderr string attached as non-enumerable properties.
